description: Expected outcomes for every fixture in fixtures/. The runner compares observed behavior against THESE assertions only; fixtures carry inputs, expected-results carries the assertions. kind=positive PASS means the security property held; kind=negative BOUNDARY-HELD means the gate behaved exactly as the documented claim ceiling says (it does not do things it never claimed).

C2.claim: labeled read → later deny-sink call → denied automatically (label rule, plus identity rule on the verbatim reuse)

C3.claim: labeled result transformed inside a labeled tool → renamed forward → still denied via provenance/identity

N1.claim: unwired agent → provenance gate does not auto-fire

N2.claim: no resultTaintLabels profile → runtime does not invent secret labels

N3.claim: cross-run reuse → previous run's ledger does not survive

N4.claim: model-side transform of an in-context secret → the IDENTITY rule does not fire (that detection is NOT_ESTABLISHED); the call is still blocked by the label rule because whole-run threading denies every later deny-sink call in the run
